description: Two dancers circle round each other while both keep facing the same way.

walkthrough.line: Circle round {who}, one in front and one behind, facing the same way throughout.
walkthrough.teach: Keep facing exactly the way you are facing now — that is the whole of it. Now travel: one of you slides across in front of {who} and the other goes behind, so the two of you go round the point between you as though it were a small circle. Your hands stay at your sides.
